decisions_taken_as_defaults.event_store: append-only JSONL at <avaDir>/quarantine/module_file_events.jsonl, fsync on append. The connector has no database; the order allows a table or an append-only store.
decisions_taken_as_defaults.frozen_registration: a file registered in MANIFEST.json or MANIFEST_APPEND.json is refused (registered_in_frozen_manifest): D6 de-registration would edit a frozen file. Fragments under references/manifest/ are de-registered, as D6 requires, because they are the module_write registrations the order targets. Raised for decision.
decisions_taken_as_defaults.path_form: module_delete takes the path exactly as skill_audit lists it, starting "modules/", with no prefix stripping, so double-nested copies (modules/modules/...) can be named. A path without the prefix is refused (outside_modules).
decisions_taken_as_defaults.c_g_calibration: self-calibrating per run on a ten-module sample: not_run below ten, dropped above 20%
decisions_taken_as_defaults.c_k: left for the gateway (2.366.0), which runs vault_provenance_audit; the connector holds no provenance records
decisions_taken_as_defaults.specialist_loader: skill_load_specialist left first-wins (a dispatch change); C-C reports where it disagrees with the compile
